items.name: theme
items.title: House Theme
items.description: Mantine theme with house defaults for Button, Card, Paper and Modal.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centered empty/zero-data placeholder with an optional icon and call to action.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: Heading text shown below the icon.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.description: Supporting text rendered under the title; nothing renders when omitted.

EmptyState.name: icon
EmptyState.description: Custom icon rendered inside the theme icon circle; defaults to an inbox icon.

EmptyState.name: action
EmptyState.description: Renders a button below the description that calls onClick when clicked; no button renders when omitted.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page title, description and right-aligned action slot with an optional divider.

PageHeader.name: title
PageHeader.description: Renders as the header's order-2 title text.

PageHeader.name: description
PageHeader.description: Renders dimmed helper text beneath the title when provided.

PageHeader.name: actions
PageHeader.description: Renders action controls in a trailing group aligned opposite the title.

PageHeader.name: withDivider
PageHeader.description: Controls whether a divider is rendered beneath the header content.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: Metric tile with label, value, optional icon and a trend row.

StatCard.name: label
StatCard.description: Renders the uppercase, muted caption identifying what the stat measures.

StatCard.name: value
StatCard.description: Renders the large, bold headline figure for the stat.

StatCard.name: diff
StatCard.description: Percentage change vs. the previous period; renders a colored trend row with an up/down arrow, and is hidden entirely when omitted.

StatCard.name: icon
StatCard.description: Renders inside a light-variant ThemeIcon at the top-right of the card; the icon slot is omitted entirely when not provided.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable table with loading skeletons, click-through rows and an empty state.

DataTable.name: data
DataTable.description: Rows to render. Sorting a column header does not mutate this array — internally the table sorts a copy of it and re-renders with the copy.

DataTable.name: columns
DataTable.description: Column definitions controlling header text, width, sortability and per-cell rendering.

DataTable.name: loading
DataTable.description: Shows skeleton placeholder rows instead of the table body while true.

DataTable.name: loadingRows
DataTable.description: Number of skeleton rows rendered while loading.

DataTable.name: emptyTitle
DataTable.description: Title shown by the empty state when there are no rows to display.

DataTable.name: emptyDescription
DataTable.description: Description shown by the empty state when there are no rows to display.

DataTable.name: onRowClick
DataTable.description: Makes rows clickable, enabling hover highlighting and a pointer cursor, and fires with the clicked row.

DataTable.name: getRowKey
DataTable.description: Derives the React key for each row; defaults to the row's index.

items.name: mantine-ui-license
items.title: Mantine UI License
items.description: Shared MIT license notice installed with Mantine UI-derived registry items.
items.docs: Verbatim MIT license from mantinedev/ui.mantine.dev at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908.

items.name: article-card
items.title: Article Card
items.description: Prop-driven article preview with author, rating and action affordances.

ArticleCard.name: image
ArticleCard.description: Cover image URL, rendered inside the linked card header.

ArticleCard.name: title
ArticleCard.description: Article title; also used as the image alt text and rendered as a link.

ArticleCard.name: description
ArticleCard.description: Summary text, clamped to four lines.

ArticleCard.name: authorName
ArticleCard.description: Byline shown in the card footer.

ArticleCard.name: authorAvatar
ArticleCard.description: Avatar image URL for the byline; a placeholder avatar renders when omitted.

ArticleCard.name: rating
ArticleCard.description: Text for the gradient badge over the image; no badge renders when omitted.

ArticleCard.name: href
ArticleCard.description: Destination for the image and title links.

ArticleCard.name: onLike
ArticleCard.description: Renders the like action icon and handles its click.

ArticleCard.name: onBookmark
ArticleCard.description: Renders the bookmark action icon and handles its click.

ArticleCard.name: onShare
ArticleCard.description: Renders the share action icon and handles its click.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI ArticleCard at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; demo data removed and replaced with typed props. Also accepts Mantine BoxProps, Styles API props and native div attributes.

items.name: authentication-form
items.title: Authentication Form
items.description: Login and registration form with validation and optional social callbacks.

AuthenticationForm.name: initialMode
AuthenticationForm.description: Sets which mode the form starts in; the internal toggle then switches between login and register.

AuthenticationForm.name: heading
AuthenticationForm.description: Heading text rendered as "{heading}, {mode} with" above the form, e.g. "Welcome, login with".

AuthenticationForm.name: onSubmit
AuthenticationForm.description: Called with the validated form values and current mode when the form is submitted.

AuthenticationForm.name: onGoogle
AuthenticationForm.description: Renders the Google social button and handles its click; the social row and divider are hidden entirely when neither social handler is set.

AuthenticationForm.name: onGithub
AuthenticationForm.description: Renders the GitHub social button and handles its click; the social row and divider are hidden entirely when neither social handler is set.

AuthenticationForm.name: ...others
AuthenticationForm.description: All other props are forwarded to the underlying Paper. AuthenticationFormProps extends PaperProps, and the spread is applied after the component's own radius="md", p="lg", withBorder defaults, so any of those three can be overridden by the caller.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI AuthenticationForm at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; submission and social actions are exposed as callbacks.

items.name: button-progress
items.title: Progress Button
items.description: Button with an integrated timed progress layer and completion callback.

ButtonProgress.name: idleLabel
ButtonProgress.description: Sets the label shown before the action has started.

ButtonProgress.name: progressLabel
ButtonProgress.description: Sets the label shown while progress is animating toward completion.

ButtonProgress.name: completeLabel
ButtonProgress.description: Sets the label shown once the progress run has finished.

ButtonProgress.name: durationMs
ButtonProgress.description: Controls how long the simulated progress run takes to reach completion.

ButtonProgress.name: onComplete
ButtonProgress.description: Fires once the progress bar reaches 100% and the button switches to its complete state.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI ButtonProgress at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; labels, duration and completion are configurable.

items.name: dnd-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: Accessible pointer and keyboard sortable list with reorder callbacks.

DndList.name: initialItems
DndList.description: Seeds the internal list state that the sortable items render from and reorder within.

DndList.name: onChange
DndList.description: Called with the full reordered item array whenever a drag ends on a different position.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI DndList at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; hardcoded periodic-table data was replaced with a reusable item contract.

items.name: stats-grid
items.title: Stats Grid
items.description: Responsive metric grid with custom icons, comparison labels and trends.

StatsGrid.name: items
StatsGrid.description: Renders one stat card per item, laying them out in a responsive grid that scales up to four columns on desktop based on the item count.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI StatsGrid at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; metrics and icons are supplied by the consumer.

items.name: table-sort
items.title: Sortable Table
items.description: Searchable and sortable name, email and company table with an empty state.

TableSort.name: data
TableSort.description: Rows to display, searched and sorted in place before rendering.

TableSort.name: searchPlaceholder
TableSort.description: Placeholder text for the search input above the table.

TableSort.name: emptyMessage
TableSort.description: Message rendered in a full-width row when the filtered data is empty.

TableSort.name: onRowClick
TableSort.description: Called with the row data when a table row is clicked; rows become clickable only when this is provided.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI TableSort at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; accepts consumer data and derives filtered rows without duplicating prop state.

items.name: cards-carousel
items.title: Cards Carousel
items.description: Responsive image-card carousel with consumer-owned data and optional actions.

CardsCarousel.name: items
CardsCarousel.description: Provides the ordered set of cards rendered as carousel slides.

CardsCarousel.name: actionLabel
CardsCarousel.description: Sets the label shown on each card's action button.

CardsCarousel.name: onSelect
CardsCarousel.description: Called when a card's action button is clicked and the item has no href, rendering the button and handling its click.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI CardsCarousel at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; hardcoded travel data became typed items with links or selection callbacks.

items.name: dropzone-button
items.title: Dropzone Button
items.description: Drag-and-drop file input with explicit accept, reject and picker behavior.

DropzoneButton.name: onDrop
DropzoneButton.description: Called with the accepted files when a valid drop or file-picker selection completes.

DropzoneButton.name: onReject
DropzoneButton.description: Called with the rejected files when a drop fails validation (type or size).

DropzoneButton.name: accept
DropzoneButton.description: Restricts accepted uploads to the given MIME types.

DropzoneButton.name: maxSize
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the maximum accepted file size in bytes.

DropzoneButton.name: multiple
DropzoneButton.description: Allows selecting or dropping more than one file at a time.

DropzoneButton.name: disabled
DropzoneButton.description: Disables both the dropzone and the trigger button.

DropzoneButton.name: idleLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the heading text shown while the dropzone is idle, and doubles as its accessible label.

DropzoneButton.name: acceptLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the heading text shown while a dragged file is being validated as acceptable.

DropzoneButton.name: rejectLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the heading text shown while a dragged file would be rejected.

DropzoneButton.name: description
DropzoneButton.default: "Drag and drop files here, or use the file picker."
DropzoneButton.description: Renders supporting text below the heading describing how to use the dropzone.

DropzoneButton.name: buttonLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the label of the button that opens the native file picker.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI DropzoneButton at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; drop/reject callbacks, constraints and user-facing text are configurable.
